title: Features
items:
[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*] Portrait overlays for unconscious, recovery coma, dying, and playing dead.
[*] Portrait overlays and text support for starving, crippled arm, and crippled leg.
[*] Configurable icon/text size, corner, and edge margin behavior.
[*] Optional Mod Hub integration for in-game settings changes.
[/list]
